name: LeLales: Fluid Love
overview:
Welcome to "LeLaLes: Fluid Love", a high-quality queer women dating show, passionately created by a team of certified Chinese gays.

Eight Chinese women will move into a quaint villa for seven days. In this safe and intimate space, they'll get to know each other, go on dates, have deep chats and explore different kinds of connections. We'll be there to catch every moment as sparks fly, friendships form, and yes - someone might just U-Haul by day three.
